launches.body:
👋 We’re **Yuma (YC W23)**, an AI support platform for e-commerce, and today we’re launching one of our biggest updates yet: **Flows**, a visual automation builder for ecommerce support.

**Flows** expands Yuma’s AI agents’ capabilities with a visual builder for explicit, deterministic steps. You can now combine process-based AI agents with the reliability of a flow for faster, more precise CX automation.

### **Why we built it**

For more than 2 years, Yuma has helped merchants automate customer support using our natural-language AI Agents builder, resolving over 5 million tickets to date. But as merchants grow, they need more control, advanced workflows, and precision while staying flexible and easy to maintain.

That’s why we built **Flows**, a visual, step-by-step builder that adds structure, clarity, and reliability to AI automation.

### **What it does**

Flows let merchants visually define how an SOP (Standard Operating Procedure) runs, step by step and action by action. Each step is visible, enforced, and powered by a mix of good old hard code and LLMs.

Flows combine quick ramp-up and adaptability with _strict step-by-step control_ where it matters.

With Flows, you can:

* Build if/then logic visually with guaranteed execution
* Combine AI conversations and deterministic rules
* Review and debug complex automations in minutes
* Gather clear insights and metrics on automation paths
* Use hooks and ordered API & CRM calls for full consistency

### **Why it matters**

Flows make automation more reliable and easier to maintain. It brings three major advantages:

**Step-by-step precision:** Every action runs exactly as designed, with enterprise-grade reliability you can trust.\
**Visual clarity:** Instantly see, review, and debug every step of your automations, no guessing or black boxes.\
**Hybrid flexibility:** Combine LLM adaptability with structured, reliable workflows for the best of both worlds.

The result is higher accuracy, fewer escalations, and faster resolutions, all in a visual format you can refine in minutes.

### **Looking for**

Contact Guillaume, the founder, at [g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai](mailto:g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai) for early access.

launches.title: Sales AI: Shopify product Q&A widget that boosts revenue
launches.tagline: AI-powered PDP widget that answers shoppers' hesitations instantly
launches.body:
👋 We are Yuma, YC W23. Today, on top of already automating customer service for more than a hundred merchants, we are launching our latest product: **Sales AI**

Sales AI is a product Q&A widget dedicated to Shopify. It sits on each PDP (product page), suggests the top questions a shopper is likely to ask, and answers instantly. If they want more, a lightweight chat opens with a fuller answer. From there, they can add to cart inside the chat or get more recommendations.

Why this matters: because the future is shopping, not chat! Shoppers want info delivered to them before they ask for it! Most drops happen on PDPs because of missing information.

Sales AI reduces that friction and in controlled A/B tests lifts conversion by up to 14%! It also records what people asked, which answers helped, and where they still hesitated, so as a brand, you see the "why" behind purchases and bounces.

**What’s different:**

* Tailored FAQs per product and per visitor behavior
* Uses your existing Shopify data + policies + prior support knowledge
* A/B test friendly; 2-click to install; doesn’t slow the site
* Full dashboard & insights with Yuma-driven revenue/purchases, impressions, interaction rate

One of our early partners, **Parachute Home**, credits the product with improving both customer experience and revenue. “Our shoppers love the interactive FAQ widget. They get answers fast, and on desktop, in one A/B test, we saw our Revenue Per Visitor increase +18% and our Average Order Value +4% - Mehdi Ait Oufkir, CEO of Parachute Home.”

**The demo video:**

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XcRN5GQ89hk

**Looking for:**

Do you own any D2C stores with a bit of traffic and are you willing to try Sales AI and give us blunt feedback? 👀 We'll help set it up, watch the numbers with you, and iterate!

Contact Guillaume, the founder at [g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai](mailto:g-sales-ai-launch@yuma.ai) in order to get priority setup.

**What's Yuma's other product?**

We also offer AI agents dedicated to support and e-commerce! Our top brands automate up to 70% of their CX with us. :)

launches.body:
**TL;DR:** _Thousands of large Shopify stores all share the same pain: a costly and inefficient customer support. Yuma leverages LLMs and integrates directly with help desks to automate away their high volume of support requests._

## **The Yuma Story**

Hi everyone,

I'm G and I'm very pleased to be launching [Yuma](https://yuma.ai), my third company!

**I did YC twice before** already, with Socialcam (W12) and Triplebyte (S15). It seems like I just can't help myself, and I had to do it all over again.

This time around, however, it's a little bit special as Yuma was launched by accident 🤷‍♂️. I released a prototype in December 2022, and my inbox was inundated with installation requests from Shopify merchants. That's when I knew I was onto something, and I decided to take the plunge. Having experienced that roller coaster ride before, I know exactly what I am signing up for again and I am thrilled about the long and eventful journey that lies ahead.

## **Why do Shopify merchants need Yuma?**

There are thousands of Shopify merchants around the world generating $10M+ a year, and they all have one thing in common: **they all hate customer support**. It's a burden for them and a huge source of cost as **they receive hundreds of requests per day**. Some of them have dozens of support agents on staff, usually offshore, and the overall quality is still often pretty poor, while staff turnover remains high.

Those merchants have been promised automation for years, but the technology has always fallen short, leaving them disappointed. As customers, we have all had to live through a terrible support automation experience before, so it's no secret that **the available current solutions are pretty bad**.

**This has to change**, and we believe that the technology is finally there to fix this problem once and for all. Of course, our goal is for Yuma to do it :)

## **The main things Yuma can do for merchants today:**

* **One-click install** into **help desks**: **no configuration required**, zero adoption cost, and no change in workflows for the support agents.
* By **combining LLMs with custom knowledge bases**, Yuma suggests drafts to support agents.
* By analyzing historical tickets, Yuma can **copy the writing style of any brand**, but also understand and **replicate their current workflows** autonomously.
* By bringing the power of LLMs to rules and templates, Yuma delivers a new type of dynamic workflow that wasn't possible before.

Yuma is already live on Gorgias at the moment, and our Zendesk app will be live in a few weeks.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=69885&key=user_uploads/37163/858ab524-d3ce-461b-968c-43ba41dea793)


## **Our ask 🙏**

Do a good deed today and **save a Shopify merchant in your network by telling them about Yuma**. They will be forever grateful! Not only that, they will receive a white-glove onboarding experience along with a 7-day free trial. :)

— —

Thank you for reading!

🔥

launches.title: Vaero - AI for Patent Lawyers
launches.tagline: We save patent lawyers hours of time on their slowest and most laborious task - drafting patent applications
launches.body:
**Tl;dr: Vaero is AI software to help patent lawyers work 5x faster. It drafts an entire patent application with AI based on invention information. The software includes a complete platform for patent lawyers to use AI for reviewing patent applications, responding to office actions, and enhancing invention disclosures.**

**🔬 The Problem:**

Patent lawyers spend hours drafting patent applications, which can be dozens and even hundreds of pages long. Patent applications include lots of detailed technical description about inventions in a formalistic way that is slow and laborious to write. Many patent lawyers find writing these technical descriptions to be their least favorite part of the job given that it can be tedious.

Moreover, the time-consuming nature of patent application drafting is also a major business problem for patent attorneys. Budgets per patent application have been on a flat or declining trend over the last two decades due to increased client demands. As a result, patent attorneys find themselves having to write patent applications with a smaller and smaller budget, which has led to increased time pressure. In some firms, patent application drafting has become an unprofitable loss leader that only serves to retain clients for more profitable legal services.

In addition to drafting patent applications, patent attorneys also deal with large volumes of documents in the other parts of their job. They often have to analyze long patent documents; they have to respond to patent application rejections from the patent office, which can be dozens of pages long; and they have to work with varying levels of invention information, which range from a few sentences to entire manuscripts.

**🪄 The Solution:**

Vaero is AI software built specifically for patent lawyers to speed up their patent drafting and other daily tasks:

* Vaero drafts an entire patent application using AI based on the same inputs that patent lawyers use
* Patent applications are written to the highest legal standards, based on our CEO’s ten years as a patent lawyer including at one of the biggest U.S. law firms
* Automatically review existing patent applications to assist with legal analysis
* Enhance invention disclosures from inventors

**⭐️ Why us?**

We are [Bryant](https://www.linkedin.com/in/bryant-lee/) and [Earl](https://www.linkedin.com/in/earlhathaway/), 2nd time founders whose prior startups have collectively raised $80M+.

* Bryant has been a patent lawyer for ten years and previously co-founded Cognition IP, a legal tech startup in the patent field which achieved 7 figures of annual revenue and was backed by Khosla Ventures, Mayfield Fund, and Y Combinator. He was a patent lawyer at Covington & Burling, one of the biggest law firms in the U.S., and graduated from Harvard Law School where he was on the law review. Prior to that he was a Ph.D. candidate in Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon.
* Earl previously co-founded a successful legal compliance startup called DataGrail (Series C, raised $84M), which sells privacy software to the legal departments of large enterprises. Prior to DataGrail, he has been a technical and product leader at many startups.

![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/WX1askFb1Wr4isgeEJJNjiF-3ksFsLa67Kwt93RZ6TiiDP1b7VxjVq-CCnnk0uIKtCO3_7WucjnKx0xtXdPaiRKu1F7BSyqtTgmAH0CBVdcu6X6NRZEH932WhuTkR4ki404crxQuF0WdWQJMOyRPDLg)

**🎉 Interested?**

If you’re thinking about how to draft patent applications more efficiently, book a [call](https://calendly.com/bryant-lee-sf/15min) with us or reach out to [founders@vaero.co](mailto:founders@vaero.co)

launches.title: Pando Bioscience: Empowering Pharma with AI-Optimized Enzymes
launches.tagline: Unlocking the full potential of enzymes to drive down costs and boost productivity in pharma
launches.body:
Pando is an AI-driven synthetic biology company revolutionizing enzyme engineering for pharma. Our ultra-high-throughput screening platform screens 1000 times more enzymes, 75% faster, and 80% cheaper than traditional methods. This empowers our generative AI to optimize enzymes across multiple properties, delivering high-performing, tailored enzymes that cut costs and enhance efficiency.

### The Problem

Enzymes play a crucial role in driving market growth and profitability in the pharmaceutical industries. Inefficient or underutilized enzymes can lead to significant financial losses and missed opportunities. Therefore, developing optimized enzymes that possess a balance of key properties becomes a top priority but remains challenging and time-consuming.

### Our Solution

Our AI model designs enzymes with specific mutations that enhance multiple properties simultaneously. These AI-generated enzymes are tested using our unique ultra-high-throughput one-pot screening platform. This platform converts diverse biological signals into abundant and quantifiable data under various conditions. By integrating AI design with advanced screening, we’ve reduced the design-build-test-learn cycle to just one month. We efficiently evaluate enzyme performance across different criteria tackling the challenge of multi-property optimization.

At Pando, we help pharma companies improve existing enzymes and discover new ones, cutting costs and boosting productivity. We are also developing our own proprietary enzyme assets.

### Our Team

We are experts in the field. @Will joined the synthetic biology unicorn Ginkgo Bioworks as an early employee. @Yang spent 6 years at Harvard Medical School before joining Ginkgo. AI-guided enzyme engineering is in our wheelhouse.

### Want to be part of it?

If you are from a **pharma, diagnostic, or biotech company** and are interested in taking enzyme engineering to the next level, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at [founders@pando.bio](mailto:founders@pando.bio).

Thank you!
